description: This file defines custom exception classes and utility functions for error handling in pandas-on-Spark, including specific error classes, a hint function for code migration, and a test function for validation.

classes.name: SparkPandasIndexingError
classes.description: Custom exception for indexing errors in pandas-on-Spark.

classes.name: SparkPandasNotImplementedError
classes.description: Exception indicating a Spark pandas function is not implemented.

classes.name: PandasNotImplementedError
classes.description: Exception indicating a pandas function or property is not implemented or deprecated.

methods.name: code_change_hint
methods.description: Provides a hint message for code migration from pandas to Spark functions.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs doctest-based tests for the exceptions module.
